title: Test launcher focused mode on Windows B loses shell-child stdout/stderr (0-byte logs for bash-wrapped commands)
outcome: Test launcher focused mode on Windows B loses shell-child stdout/stderr (0-byte logs for bash-wrapped commands)
acceptance: A bash-wrapped focused launcher command on Windows B captures its stdout and stderr (including xtrace) in the run's logs, shown by a smoke that echoes a sentinel to both streams.
The cause is identified with discriminating evidence, and a regression test covers shell-child output capture on Windows.
